operation.summary: Watch activity on the selected monitoring phone for one approved registry edition. For the owner's Bridgit app on iPhone & iPad, over the relay; read-only.
operation.returns: template, revision, watches[{key,state:scheduled|paused|budget_paused|blocked|ended,checks?,matches?,last_check_at?,last_outcome?:error|skipped|match|no_match|checked}]. Declared status sources add recent_checks[{at,matched?|outcome?}]; tally sources add tally{today{checks,watched_minutes,labels},episodes[{start,label,minutes}]}, newest 20 from the last day.
